title: Little Light
style: Festive village folk (fiddle, flute, frame drum, accordion) that falls into a fragile music-box motif for Glim; a dark storm of low strings and thunder; a rising wordless choir pad and glockenspiel for the transformation.
key: D major -> B minor -> D major
rules: Original instrumental only. No vocals, no lyrics, no spoken word.

hit_points.cue: Festival fiddle tune starts loud, then drops to Glim's music-box motif.
Festival tune continues in the background, slightly muffled.
A playful fiddle phrase, then thunder rumbles underneath.
Glim's music-box motif plays bravely over the storm.
Music-box motif joined by harp; the storm strings fade.
Festival fiddle returns softly, slowed and warm.
Glim's three-note motif played big by the full ensemble; final D major chord at the cut.

end_card.cue: Music resolves on the final chord exactly at the cut; ODDLY sting plays over 2.0s end card.
